findings.evidence: MazurFiniteness.lean:92-93 `def MazurFiniteness (p) (G) : Prop := ∀ U : OpenSubgroup G, Finite (continuousZModDual p U.toSubgroup)`. The Mazur corollary only needs `[CompactSpace G]`, and G_{K,S} is compact: line 91 already infers `U.FiniteIndex` for an open subgroup of it. `grep MazurFiniteness TauCeti/NumberTheory` finds nothing.
findings.fix: State `mazurFiniteness_galoisGroupS (S) (hS : S.Finite) (m) [NeZero m] : MazurFiniteness m (galoisGroupS K Ω S)`. Then either drop the G_{K,S} cocycle theorem or prove it as `(mazurFiniteness_galoisGroupS S hS m).exists_openNormalSubgroup_forall_mem_Z1 U`.
findings.issue: `finite_continuousZModDual S hS U m : Finite (continuousZModDual m U)` for every open `U` is exactly the definition of `MazurFiniteness m (galoisGroupS K Ω S)`, written out per subgroup instead of using the named predicate. As a result, `exists_openNormalSubgroup_forall_mem_Z1` (line 84) repeats `MazurFiniteness.exists_openNormalSubgroup_forall_mem_Z1` for one group.

findings.evidence: LowDegree.lean:509-511 defines `Z1` under `[Mul G] ... [DistribSMul G M]`. LowDegree.lean:1062-1067 states the sibling `map_mul_of_smul_eq_self_of_mem_Z1 [Mul G]` with `[DistribSMul G M]`.
findings.fix: Weaken to `{G} [Mul G] [TopologicalSpace G] ... [DistribSMul G B]`, matching `map_mul_of_smul_eq_self_of_mem_Z1`.
findings.issue: `apply_mul_eq_of_mem_Z1` assumes `[Monoid G]` and `[DistribMulAction G B]`. The proof only uses the cocycle identity and `smul_zero`, which hold under `[Mul G]` and `[DistribSMul G B]`.

summary: The abstract uniform-vanishing theorem is at the right level, but the G_{K,S} finiteness lemma spells out `MazurFiniteness m (galoisGroupS K Ω S)` by hand instead of stating it, so the arithmetic cocycle theorem duplicates the Mazur corollary. `apply_mul_eq_of_mem_Z1` also assumes more than its sibling cocycle lemmas.
